inv.desc_en:
Excellent commercial premises, very well connected, 5 minutes from the Town Hall square, with all services nearby, on one of the main commercial arteries of Valencia.

It consists of 250 square meters.

Marble flooring.

Smooth walls.

High coffered ceilings, removable in some areas.

Open-plan customer service area.

Back room area.

Storage room.

2 bathrooms (1 adapted).

Air conditioning.

Electricity and water utilities connected.

2 months deposit + guarantees depending on profile.

We offer a technical visit service prior to the formalization of the lease, at no cost, to confirm the suitability of the premises for the intended activity.

This advertisement is merely informative and in no case shall it have contractual value.
